finalResult.nextParagraphText: Yggdrasil said, finally turning her head toward the other goddess present.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I was worried at first, but if we use the Records in this bow as the base, I believe it’s possible,” Nature’s Attendant nodded. “It was directly granted by the system, and the conceptual complexity reflects that.”
